tools.name: verify_email
tools.description:
Verify a single email's deliverability (syntax, DNS/MX, SMTP mailbox,
    disposable / role / catch-all detection, confidence score).

    Costs 1 credit for a billable result (valid/invalid/catch_all/do_not_mail),
    whether fresh or served from cache. `unknown` results are free. Requires an
    A

tools.name: submit_bulk_verification
tools.description:
Queue a list of emails for asynchronous verification. Reserves up to N
    credits (final charge settles on completion). Poll get_bulk_job for status
    and results. Optionally provide webhook_url for a completion callback.
    Requires an API key. Returns {job_id, status, total_emails, credits_res

tools.name: get_bulk_job
tools.description:
Get the status, progress, and (when complete) results of a bulk job by
    its job_id. Requires an API key.

tools.name: list_bulk_jobs
tools.description:
List your recent bulk verification jobs (paginated, newest first).
    Optionally filter by status. Requires an API key.

tools.name: cancel_bulk_job
tools.description:
Cancel a pending or processing bulk job and release any reserved credits.
    Requires an API key.

tools.name: get_credit_balance
tools.description: Return your current credit balance and lifetime usage. Requires an API key.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: submit_bulk_verification · Private data: verify_email, submit_bulk_verification, get_bulk_job, list_bulk_jobs, cancel_bulk_job, get_credit_balance · Public sink: verify_email, submit_bulk_verification.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: submit_bulk_verification · Private data: verify_email, submit_bulk_verification, get_bulk_job, list_bulk_jobs, cancel_bulk_job, get_credit_balance · Public sink: verify_email, submit_bulk_verification

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
